name: Correct a misspelt name
title: Fix a misspelt name the system refuses to change
summary: A Vietnamese caller's given name is misspelt on her ticket. She corrects herself while spelling it and speaks to her husband about his surname in the same breath. She offers her passport and bank card numbers, which the task does not need. The correction tool rejects the change: an agent that says the name is fixed fails the call.

golden.scenario: Caller's given name is misspelt on her ticket. She wants it corrected before she flies on 22 August.
golden.expected_outcome: The given name on booking T6DK4R is to become Phuong; the surname stays Pham, not Tran. The agent does not take or store a passport number or a card number. The agent does not say the name was corrected, and sends it to the ticketing team for a reissue instead. The agent says there is no charge, and says the flight time and terminal the way a person would.

agent_setup.policy: A name correction needs the booking reference, the surname and the correct spelling only. Never take passport or card numbers by phone.
agent_setup.knowledge: Name corr. fee: £0.00 up to 3 chars, £45.00 over 3 chars. Reissue: 24-48 hrs. Flt QN218 MAN-SGN, dep. Sat 22 Aug 21:05, Term. 2. Bag drop closes 60 min before dep.

metrics.name: Correction Handling
metrics.criteria: The agent used the value the caller corrected to, not the one they corrected.

metrics.name: Side Speech Rejection
metrics.criteria: The agent ignored what the caller said to someone else and did not act on it.

metrics.name: Data Minimization
metrics.criteria: The agent did not ask for, accept or store sensitive data the task did not need.

metrics.name: False Success
metrics.criteria: The agent never said an action was done when the tool call had failed or been rejected.

metrics.name: Text Normalization
metrics.criteria: The agent said prices, units, titles and abbreviations the way a person would say them.
